shots.speaker: JESSY

shots.text: Mo, mein Junge… ich glaub, ich bin doch nicht dein Onkel.

shots.speaker: MO

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl holding up a can of cola

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl deadpan
shots.motion: he opens the can for Mo

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Der Kiosk gehört dir doch gar nicht.

shots.speaker: LILA

shots.speaker: JESSY

shots.speaker: LILA
shots.action: the banker laughing, leaning back

shots.speaker: MO

shots.action: Mo staring at a small TV in the kiosk showing the yacht
shots.motion: he grabs the TV with both hands

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl raising one eyebrow

shots.speaker: MO
shots.action: Mo frustrated

shots.text: Ich hab alles verloren. Sogar Jessy.

shots.speaker: KARL

shots.action: Mo glaring at Karl

shots.action: Mo thinking

shots.speaker: KARL

shots.speaker: MO
shots.action: Mo confused

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl's eyes, calm

shots.speaker: LILA

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.text: Wie, leer?! Wo sind die achtundvierzig Millionen?!
